'''Barrett Leddy''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Leddy was born on May 6, 1992, and became an actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced recurring character [[Molayne]]. Leddy is currently based in New York City, where he is represented by Access Talent's Next Generation VO. In 2022, Leddy took over several of [[Billy Kametz]]'s roles following his death, most notably that of [[Goh's Inteleon]] and [[Ren]].
